questions.prompt: What was world GDP per person in 2024, in dollars? (Adjusted for price differences between countries, PPP, in constant 2021 international dollars, per the World Bank.)
questions.insight: Measured at market exchange rates in current US dollars, world GDP per person was only about $13,700 in 2024.

questions.prompt: Around the year 1800, by historians' estimates, what share of the world's children died before reaching their fifth birthday?
questions.insight: Through at least 1800, more than one in three children failed to reach age five, according to Our World in Data.

questions.prompt: According to UNODC estimates, what was the global intentional homicide rate in 2024, in killings per 100,000 people?

source.name: UNODC (via UN Sustainable Development Goals Report 2026)

questions.insight: The global rate has fallen from 5.9 per 100,000 in 2015, according to UNODC data reported in the UN SDG report.

questions.prompt: According to WHO, smallpox killed an estimated how many people in the 20th century alone, before its eradication?
questions.insight: Before it was wiped out, smallpox had plagued humanity for at least 3,000 years.

questions.prompt: What was the average concentration of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere at Mauna Loa Observatory, Hawaii, in 2025 (annual mean, in parts per million), according to NOAA?
questions.insight: The 2025 annual mean was about 2.7 ppm higher than 2024's 424.6 ppm.
